name: Expanded Collective [Psionic]
body:
You are able to include more creatures into your collective.

Prerequisite: Collective class feature.

Benefit: You may add two additional creatures into your collective.

Normal: Your collective can contain a number of creatures equal to half your class level or your key ability modifier, whichever is greater.

Special: You may take this feat multiple times; its benefits stack.
